correctness.rationale: Differentiate the kernel explicitly and normalize c=1 and |d/c|=t; numerator P=(1-ab)^2+beta*t*(a+b)*(1-ab)+beta*t²*(1+beta*ab). For boundary a,b on T, two real equations reduce to Q_beta(t²)=beta(1-beta)(t²-4/(1-beta))(t²+4/beta)<=0, with Q_1=-4t²-16. Strictly subcritical boundary roots are nondegenerate in both angles, so IFT yields interior zeros. For supercritical t, the large-t limit beta*(1+beta ab) is uniformly zero-free and argument-principle zero count persists on connected t region; Rouché rules out a threshold interior root. Pure derivative has numerator beta(1+beta ab), zero-free for beta<=1. Independent exact factorization and five torus roots checked. No finite grid substituted for analytic bidisk proof.
